decisions.rationale: "Emerin deficiency" describes a molecular finding (reduced emerin protein at the nuclear membrane), not a named disease. "Deficiency" is a general term that the guidelines exclude.
"Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy" is a named disease entity referred to as one specific condition in this text, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease.
"X-linked Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy" is the most specific form of the disease, so the whole phrase including the qualifier "X-linked" is annotated as one Specific Disease.

decisions.rationale: "EDMD" is the abbreviation of Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy, given in parentheses. Abbreviations are annotated as a separate mention from the long form.
"neuromuscular diseases" refers to a family of many different diseases rather than one specific disease, so it is a Disease Class.

"EDMD" appears as the object of "other than" in "neuromuscular diseases other than EDMD", not as a modifier of a noun. It refers to one specific disease, and this is a duplicate mention that is annotated again.
In "EDMD patients", the disease name directly modifies the noun "patients", as with "HNPCC kindreds" in the guideline example, so it is annotated as a Modifier.
"EDMD" appears in the prepositional phrase "patients with EDMD" and is not directly modifying a noun, so it is a Specific Disease mention.
